visualReview.notes: All ten current standard frames inspected after the reversed shell, basement bank, upper arched window and entrance roof corrections. The restored ochre form, rounded southern workroom, north terrace, sculpted window breasts and closed dome remain coherent through all four turntable angles and close views.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: All ten current shared frames inspected. Lime plaster and painted roof surfaces resolve with metric scale; the restored ochre tint, window recesses, bank and rail detail retain stable faces. Entry roof seams follow the actual roof surface, and the small observing-room arch is no longer occluded.

geographicReview.notes: The exact mapped north/south main-body frame agrees with the north-up placement image. The rounded workroom is south and the entrance is north. The authored bank, daylight hoods and projecting entrance terrace legitimately extend beyond the main-body map polygon; the front stair foot establishes ground contact.

fidelityReview.notes: Passed for the detailed present exterior after comparison with the foundation's 1930 plan reproductions and 2023 restoration photographs. Handmade plaster curvature is reconstructed in the original polygonal style. The source explicitly separates the modeled exterior stair datum from the lower laboratory datum and treats the roughly 20 m published-height reconciliation as an inference. The permanent visible building, bank, windows, terrace and closed roof are complete.
